content: Utsin-utsinquien ambi naidbëdtabi Esuquidistu chuibanquin dada uaid dadpen iquec.
Aidon Esuquidistun tauain naidbëdtabi ambi naid utsitedi isted-istedquin chuibanquin chiacpaden dada uaidtedi nec.
Esuquidistu chuibanquin dada uaid isbanquimbi Esuquidistu isnëdaidon chuibanaid tantiashun aidtedi mibi chuibanquin dada uaimbi, chuiquid dapa, Teyopido.
Abimbo iquec quequin ëmbi dada uaid ma tantiapanueshun mibi chuiquin dada uaimbique. Isec onqueta.
Uan, acten mentoanquid tishte chiaid

Nidaid Udeya caid yacno Edodes cuëmëdquid ancanquid icnubien Nuquin Papan namiaidquio Sacadias cuëmëdquid icpanëdash. Aidi, Abiasën tsyuecquid Adonën tsyuecquidbidi nepanëdash. Aidi, Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid nuntanshun nashunquid icpanëdash. Aidën chido Adonën tsyuecquidbidi icpanëdash.
Aton bënëbëdi Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiaquin naquidquio icpanëdash. Adquid icsho Nuquin Papan bëdamboen isaidquio aid daëdi icpanëdash.
Edisabed bacuë tishesa icpanëdash. Adquid yequi aton bënëbëdi tsusio budpanëdash.
Adashic, Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid nuntanshun nabanuec padpidemboec Sacadias puduedpanëdash.

Ambi noadte bëda tauite ushë chonoc Sacadias aid shubun puduedpanëdash. Ënden abipadquid utsibobëdtan abi cuëmëdquid-cuëmëdquidquien dada uashun dada uatempi tëchun sandoshon cadotaniac ambi dada uatsaidëmpi abia puduenacsho isacpadec Sacadias puduedpanëdash.

Noadte bëda tauinuec utsi puduedtemaid quënë yacno puduedpanëdash. Ambo Sacadias puduedash icnubi Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid puduedte quënë yacno utsibo dadpen Nuquin Papa chiec onquecuededpanëdash.
Adnubien utsi puduedtemaid quënë yacno Sacadias icnubi ambobi Nuquin Icbon chomiaid, ambi uaid mayan bëda, chopanëdash. Noadte tauinun sanaid dayun abiucquio tabadpanëdash.
Adec tabadsho isash dacuëdampambo iquec, quetanec Sacadias uëdëquiampanëdash.

Adsho isash Nuquin Papan uaid mayan bëda nadpanëdash: —Bacuë bunquin mimbi chian-chiamboed Nuquin Papan tantiaidquio neque. Dacuëdenda, Sacadias. Min chido Edisabedën min mado tishendac. Min mado tishacsho Uan cuënta.
Min chidon tishaid isash mibi bëdambo iquendac. Aidi mibi bëdambo icmequid iquendac. Aidën chuibanaid tantiash matses dadpen bëdambo iquendac.
Aidi Nuquin Papan bëdamboen isaidquio iquendac. Paëmbocquid min madon isuidendac. Abi tishaid ushën abëd icmenuequin Nuquin Papan aton Mayan meniaidquio min mado iquendac.
Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiaquidquio icquin aidën chiac isadaidbo dadpen Nuquin Papan chiaid niacquid icboedi, Con Icbo Nuquin Papa nec, queoaindac.

Min mado Nuquin Icbo bëyucanec choendac. Tsusedpa Ediasën chiampicpadquiequi dacuëdenquio icquin cuembo chuibanquidquio min mado iquendac. Aden chuibanquid Nuquin Icbo bëyucanec choendac. Tsusedpabon tishmiaidën tsyuecquid dadpen tantiesabo icboedi min madon chiac tsusedpabopadquid tantiaquidquio nëbi tabadquido iquendac. Aido Nuquin Papan chiaid niacboedi min madon chiac Nuquin Papan chiaid naquidquio iquendac. Nuquin Icbon matses aido icmenuen min madon chuibanendac —quepanëdash Nuquin Papan uaid mayan bëda.
Aden Nuquin Papan uaid mayan bëdan chiaquien Sacadiasën: —¿Mitsipadentsimbi mimbi chuiboed tantiape? Con chidobëdi tsusio budpobi —capanëdash.
Adoaquien: —Ëbibi, Cabaded nebi. Nuquin Papan abëd tabadquin namiaidquio nebi. Nuquin Papan ambi chiacpadomboen mibi chuimenuen chomiaid nebique.

Tantia. Chuinu. Min chidon bacuë tishendac, quequin Nuquin Papan chiaid ëmbi chuiboed tantienquio icsho mibi eme uaindac. Min chidon bacuë tishan padpidec mibi onquianoaindac —quepanëdash Nuquin Papan uaid mayan bëda Sacadias caic.
Adnubien noadte bëda tauite quënënuësh Sacadias baded puduenenquiocsho isash, Baded puduenenquiocpec, quequin cainec tabadpanëdash utsibo.

Aden yuen caimbudnubien puduenash onquenuequi buëd cuëdenquiocpanëdash Sacadias. Adsho isun: —Ushquin isacbimboen isbenac —cabededpanëdash. Adnubien Sacadiasën iccuededquido nidmenuen mëdante uic-uiccapanëdash.
Adashic, Nuquin Papa tabadte shubu uashunaid nuntanshun nashunte ushëted nainash aton shubuno Sacadias nidoapanëdash.
Ambo choash yuec tabadnubien aton chidon bacuë usundopanëdash. Aden usundoash mëdante auc abentsëcted ushë nidmec aton shubu nuntan icpanëdash.

Adec tabadec Nuquin Papan naid chiec nadec Edisabed onquepanëdash: —Bacuë usundoenquiocpec, cabededboedëmbi nëbi macho budshumbi ëmbi bacuë usundoacsho utsibon ëbi isec. Ëbi tantiaquin Nuquin Papan usundomiaid nebi —quepanëdash Edisabed.
Esus tishendac, quequin chiaid
Adashic, Edisabedën bacuë usundoan ushë 6ted nidan nidaid Cadidia caid yacno shubu dadpen icquid Nasaded caid yacno Nuquin Papan Cabaded chomeoapanëdash.
Ambo aton chido bedabicquid, tsusedpa Dabidën tsyuecquid Ose cuëmëdquid icpanëdash. Aidi ambo tabadnubien uano aton chido Madia cuëmëdquid tsadacno Cabaded chopanëdash.
Adec choshon: —Mibi tantiaquin Nuquin Papan bëdamboen icmiaidquio mibi nec. Nuquin Icbo mibëdi tabadendac —capanëdash Cabadedën.
Adoaquien Madia, ¿Atotsi quepeba? quequin otacquio tantiec tsadpanëdash.
Adec tsadsho isun Cabadedën: —Dacuëdenda. Mibi bëdamboen tantiaquin Nuquin Papan naden nanu quequin chiaid nad iqueque.
Chuinu. Tantiata. Bacuë usundoshon min mado mimbi tishendac. Tishun, Ëmbi tishaid Nuquin Papa yacno yuedanquidquio nec, quequin Esus cuënta.

Mimbi tishaid chuiquid dapa iquendac. Aden mimbi tishaid isec, Nadatiambocquidën madombo nec, quecuededpendac utsibo. Tsusedpa Dabid chuiquid dapa Nuquin Papan icmiacpadomboembidi chuiquid dapa min Mado Esus icmeoaindac. Adoac Chuiquid Dapa Abentsëcquiobi aid iquendac.
Adec tsusedpa Acobon tsyuecquido ënenquiocquin chuiquid dapa min mado Esus iquendac —quepanëdash Cabaded Madia chiec.
Adoaquien: —¿Mitsipadentsimbi bacuë usundoshon bacuë tishpe? Chudabicquid nebi —quepanëdash Madia.
Adoaquien: —Nuquin Papan Mayan mibëdi tabadnuc mimbi tishendac. Aden Nadatiambocquin naidënquio Madia usundomiaid, icsa nibëdquid, Nuquin Papan madombobi nec, utsibon cabededendac.
Min utsi Edisabed macho icquin bacuë usundoenquiocboedëmbi nëbi bacuë usundoac. Usundoenquiocquid nec, cabededboedëmbi nëbi ushë 6ted nidan usundoac.
Utsin natiapimbo yaid Nuquin Papan naidquio nec —quepanëdash Cabaded.
Adoaquien Madia: —Ai, con Icbon namiaidquio nebi. Ma mimbi chiacpadquio icpanuna —quepanëdash. Aden chiaquien Cabaded nidpanëdash.
Madia Edisabed isedec nidaid
Adashic, aton na nacnenanec Madia tsusedpa Udan tsyuecquidon nidaid macuësh yacno badedi nidpanëdash.
Adec nidashic Sacadias oncamenquio yaidën shubu yacno choec puduedshun Sacadiasën chido, Edisabed istuidash: —Mibi isnuec chobi —Madia quepanëdash.
Adsho Edisabedën tantianubi aton bacuë comapenec cuididiquiampanëdash. Adec aton bacuë cuididiquenubi Nuquin Papan Mayanën tantiamiac Edisabed
Madia chiec nadec comapenec onquepanëdash: —Nuquin Papan bëdamboshë icmiaidquio mibi nec. Mimbi usundoaid adembidi bëdamboshë icmiaidquio nec.
Nuquin Icbon tita mibi yec ¿atotsi quiash ëbi isnuec cho?
Mibi isec chobi, mibi quesho ëmbi tantianubi, Cuishon, quiacbimboec con bacuë cuididiquianosh.
Nuquin Icbon tantiacpadomboen chuisho tantiaquid mibi iquec mibi bëdambo icted-ictedendac —quepanëdash Edisabed Madia chiec.
Nuquin Papan naid chiec Madia cuëdënaid
Adnubien Madia nadec onquec cuëdëmpanëdash:

content.text: “Nuquin Papan naid chuibanu. Tantia.
Ëbi usundomiaid Nuquin Papa yacno Yuedanquid nec, quequin tantiec bëdambo iquebi.
Ëbi ambi namiaid icsho bëdamboen isquin Nuquin Papan naosh.
Adoacsho, Nuquin Papan bëdamboshë icmiaid Madia nec, quequin abitedishunquio tantiabededendac.
Adembidi aton tsyuecquidon tantiabededoaic.
Nuquin Papa icsaisa iquec. Icsatiapimbo iquec.
Ambi chiaid tantiaquin naquid icsho,
Mimbi naid icsa cuidnu, quenquiocquin abëdi shubu abentsëquën tabadacbimboecnuc adquid tabadmendac.
Adenuidi tantiaquin nampidquio abi iquec.
Nadatiambocquin naded-nadedquidquio Nuquin Papa nec.
Ëmbibi tantiacpadomboen naimbi, quequid icsho isun Nuquin Papan cacumiac uano tabadendac.
Ancanquid dapa icboedi utsin namiaidquio adquid iquendac.
Utsin namiaid icboedi chuiquid Nuquin Papan icmendac.
Ambi chiaid tantiec bëdamboec tabadte comapenec bunquiacpaden naquidquio Nuquin Papan icmendac.
Con na ëmbi bedaiduidi tantiec bëdamboec tabadebi quequid unësacsho cacumiac uano tabadendac.
Chuiquid Dapa Abentsëcquiobi chidon usundoendac, quequin ambi tsusedpabo chuimiampicpadomboen Nuquin Papan ëbi usundomiac.
Tsusedpa Abadauambëdta aton tsyuecquidtedi ambi tantiampicpadomboen Nuquin Papan ëbi usundomiac.
Mimbi usundoaid ëbi yacno yuedanquid nec, quequin Nuquin Papan ambi tantiampicpadembi ëbi isec,”

content: quec comapenec cuëdënash Madia ënëdpanëdash.
Adec ënëdash Edisabedbëd ushë daëd nidmec tabadashic ushë utsi nidbudtsëcnubi aton shubuno nidoapanëdash.
Uan tishaid
Adnubien Edisabedën bacuë tishte ushë chonoc dada bacuë tishpanëdash.
Bacuë tishenquiocboedëmbi nëbi aton bacuë tishosh, quesho tantiash aton matses ado shubu utsinquidotedi Edisabedbëd bëdambo icpanëdash.
Adashic, 8tedec ushtanquin Edisabedën madon shui dëbid dëteshunu quesho tantiash utsibo cho-chopanëdash. Choash puduedash bacuëmpi aton papa cuëmëdquid cuënu quenubi
Edisabed: —Padenquio. Abi cuëmëdquid Uan nec —quepanëdash.
Adoaquien utsibo: —Min matses utsi Uan cuëmëdquid nibëdec —queshun
Sacadias ismenuequin mëdante uic-uiccaquin: —Abi cuëmëdquid chui. Tantianu —capanëdash utsibon.
Adoaquien dada uate bedshun, Abi cuëmëdquid Uan nec, quequin dada uaquin Sacadiasën ismepanëdash. Adoaquien: —¿Abimboda mimbi cape? —quecuededpanëdash utsibo.
Adnubien Nuquin Papan oncameoac Nuquin Papan naid Sacadiasën chuibampanëdash.

Aden chuibansho tantiash: —Dacuëdampambo iquec. ¿Atotsiepashun onquenquiocboedëmbi nëbi onquequin Nuquin Papan naid chuibampec? —quecuededpanëdash utsibo. Aden tantianec aton shubuno nidaneshun ambi isboedbëdtabi ambi tantiaboed utsibon chuipanëdash.
Adoac: —¿Mitsipadquidquio aton mado nepec? —quecuededpanëdash Sacadiasën mado Nuquin Papan tantiamiaidquio isbededec.
Sacadias oncamiaid
Adnubien Uanën papa Sacadias Nuquin Papan Mayanën oncamiac nadec Esus chiec onquepanëdash:

content.text: “Nuquin Papa isadaidbon Icbo nec, quequin chuibanuna.
Aidën isadaidbo icsaquid icsho cuidnushe quiash abided
cuidadquid chomiac mayan icsan yuaid icboedi aidën
mënchictequidquio isadaidbo iquendac.
Abi mënchicquid nadatiamboquid nendac.
Tsusedpa Dabidën tsyuecquidquio aid nendac.
Ambi chuimiaidon chiampicpadembi
Nuquin Papan adquidquio icmianac.
Nuquin tsusedpa Abadauan tantiaquin
Nuquin Papan ambi chiampicpadembi nuquin tsusedpabo
aton tsyuecquidbëdtabi abi chieshënquido
nidtiapimbo yacnombo abi yacno yuedanquid
Nuquin Icbo Abentsëcquiobi nec.
Abi cudasquin mënchicaid yec dacuëdenquio yec
Nuquin Papan namiaidombo iquendac.
Adquid yec icsaisa abipadquio bëdamboec tabadquid icsho
nuqui aidën isendac ënenquiocquin.”

content: Adec Esus chiec onquiashic nadec aton mado chiec Sacadias onqueoapanëdash:

content.text: “Adnubien nëbi Nuquin Papan chomiaid chuibanquidquio
mibi nec, quequin utsibon mibi cuënendac, mado.
Nuquin Icbo choec, quequin utsibon tantiabicnuc
bëyuc tantiashun abi chuiquidquio mibi iquendac.
Adquid icquin mibi icsaquid icsho cuidnushe quiash
abided cuidadquid tantiasho isash Nuquin Papa mibi icsaid tantienquio yec bëpiscudendac,
quequin chuibanquid mibi iquendac, mado.
Nuquin Papan matses tantiaquin naquidquio icquin
abipadquidquio icsaisa abi yacnoshon chomiaidquio iquendac.
Aidën tantiamiac unësash abi iquendac.
Adquid shubu abentsëquën tabadacpadec tabadendac,
quequin mimbi chiendac, mado,”

content: quec Uanën papa Sacadias Nuquin Papan Mayanën oncamiac onquepanëdash.
Matses nibëdacno Uan tabadcueniaid
Adashic, Sacadiasën bacuë Uan caniacsho Nuquin Papan tantiamiaid yequi matses nibëdacno tabadcuenepanëdash ambi Esus chuibante ushë choabicnuc.
